name: Discrete Volume Rendering Integral (VRI)
definition: Fragment shader computes VRI by iterating along segment between entry $s_{in}$ and exit $s_{out}$ in steps of $\Delta s$.
summary: The Discrete Volume Rendering Integral computes pixel color by discretizing the volume equation into a fixed-step Riemann sum within a fragment shader, distinguishing itself from adaptive methods by relying on pre-computed texture coordinates and strict step sizes.
